script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: “Nobody had turned back yet” goes beyond Jeremiah’s statement that the people had not listened.
The claim that elders were around is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
The explanation makes the gift of the land the reason the people should serve the LORD. The passage does not state that connection.
The claim that Egypt was a neighbor of Judah is a fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
The description of Babylon as a great kingdom far from Judah adds a fact outside this passage without a reference.
The statement that Pharaoh Neco was Egypt’s king is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
The explanation says “Wrong” about the baker’s answer. Its statement that Cyrus was king of Persia is also a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
“Nobody on that stretch of the map was left out” extends the statement about the land, its residents and surrounding nations to every individual.
The statement that Sheba is a place in the Bible refers outside this passage and needs a reference.
The explanation calls everything in the list sounds, but the list also includes the light of the lamp.
Verse 9 calls Nebuchadnezzar the LORD’s servant, not Babylon.
Chaldeans is not another name for the land; the verse calls it the land of the Chaldeans. It also calls Nebuchadnezzar, not the land, the LORD’s servant.
